lbl_results: Transcription results (Enter to play, F2 to edit):
msg_select_segment_first: Select a line in the results first.
shortcut_enter_play: Enter on a result line: play that segment.
shortcut_context_menu: Applications key or Shift+F10 on a line: play/edit menu.
shortcut_switch_tabs: Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab: switch between the Transcription and Search tabs.
shortcut_edit_dialog: In the edit window: F5 to listen, Ctrl+Enter to save, Esc to cancel.
shortcut_processing: In the processing window: Ctrl+I for progress, Esc to cancel. Progress is announced every 10%.
shortcut_dict_delete: In the custom dictionary: Enter to add, Delete to remove the selected word.
shortcut_escape: Esc: close any dialog without saving.
msg_resume_found:
Part of «{file}» was already transcribed ({count}, up to {reached} of {total}).
Continue from there?
msg_pending_on_startup:
Last time, transcribing «{file}» did not finish (reached {reached} of {total}).
Continue now?
msg_canceled_saved: Transcription canceled. The part done so far (up to {reached}) is saved and shown; press Start to continue from there.
report_speed_tip: Note: transcription took about {factor}x the audio length on this computer. If speed matters more than accuracy, try a smaller model such as small (Settings, Ctrl+P) after downloading it (Ctrl+D). A graphics card (GPU) is much faster if available.
msg_busy_try_later: The program is busy transcribing. Open the new file after the current transcription finishes.
